label: TP
reason: User input from queryString flows through doSomething (preserved via Base64 roundtrip) into bar, then concatenated with TESTFILES_DIR to form fileName. fileName is passed to FileInputStream/FileOutputStream without validation, enabling path traversal. Although XSS sink applies encoding, the Path Injection sink represents a genuine vulnerability on the reported path.

evidence.note: fileName constructed from user input and used in file stream operations
doSanitizes input via Base64 roundtrip but preserves content allowing path traversal
